title: Made a little strategy game for fun, figured some of you might like it
author: ExternalBee1529
selftext:
Hi,

For the past while I've been making a strategy game somewhat similar to Diplomacy (with a lot more content) in my spare time, mostly just to play with friends and family. We've had a lot of fun with it, so I thought I'd share it here since. I originally planned this as a board game and wanted to test virtually, but eventually I just ended up polishing the virtual version.

Everyone puts down their orders in secret (moving armies, recruiting, building etc.), then everything gets revealed and resolved. You can make alliances, trade, send envoys and declare war on each other. There are also barbarians wandering around and random weather events that can ruin your plans. You can pick from a few different maps too (I am currently creating more).

You can play online with friends, all on the same computer, or alone against AI. The AIs have their own personalities and are getting quite good. Some like building, some like fighting, and one is a bit of a trickster. They make deals and hold grudges, and they'll gang up on you if you get too far ahead.

It runs in the browser, so no install needed: [https://harvest-and-war.vercel.app](https://harvest-and-war.vercel.app)

It's just a hobby project, and I've had a lot of fun. It's not visually as great as some stuff you see here, but I think the mechanics are very polished. Would be cool to hear what you think!
